//: Copy this file to config.json and fill in real values. config.json is gitignored.
//protocol: sftp (default for Pterodactyl, port 2022) or ftp. Used by both --deploy and --upload.
//host: Hostname or IP of the server (no protocol prefix).
//port: FTP plain/explicit-TLS is usually 21. Pterodactyl SFTP is usually 2022.
//user: FTP/SFTP username. Pterodactyl SFTP usernames look like 'user.serverid'.
//secure: FTP only. true = explicit FTPS (FTP over TLS). false = plain FTP. Ignored for sftp.
//remoteBase: Remote directory the pack lives in. mods/ and config/ are created/synced under this. Typically '/' for Pterodactyl (the server root). Used by both --deploy and --upload.
//concurrency: --deploy only: number of parallel upload connections. Default 4. Lower it if your host limits simultaneous SFTP sessions.
//compress: SFTP only: enable SSH transport compression (true/false). Default false. Mod jars are already compressed, so this rarely helps and costs CPU.
//pterodactyl: OPTIONAL. If present, --deploy auto-decompresses the uploaded zip via the panel client API. OMIT this whole block to instead be prompted to decompress the zip by hand (panel File Manager or WinSCP).

pterodactyl.//panelUrl: Base URL of your panel, no trailing slash, e.g. 'https://panel.your-host.net'.
pterodactyl.//apiKey: A CLIENT API key (Account -> API Credentials). Starts with 'ptlc_'. Never commit this.
pterodactyl.//serverId: Short server id from the panel URL (panel.host/server/<serverId>), e.g. 'a1b2c3d4'.
